svg.title: Match the Need to the Feature
svg.desc: Matching the need to the feature: a quick one-off question goes to chat, recurring work with the same files and rules to a Project, a question spread across many sources to Research, and something to keep, edit or share to an artifact.
svg.text: Match the Need to the Feature
The lightest feature that fits the shape of the work.
Fastest; context stays in that chat
Same files and rules, many chats
Cited report; web search on; paid plans
Something to keep, edit or share
Beside the chat; code execution on
